title: Central Banks Prepare for a Hawkish Week
en: A slide in the dollar took a pause on Thursday as investors positioned for a wave of central bank meetings next week, where policymakers in Japan, the United States and Europe are all expected to hold rates but keep a hawkish tone. The Federal Reserve is seen leaving its funds rate at 3.75 to 4 percent this month, with traders pricing a high chance of an increase in December. The European Central Bank is expected to keep its benchmark at 2.5 percent, while the Bank of Japan is not expected to lift its rate to 1.5 percent until early next year. Japanese policymakers say underlying inflation is quite close to the 2 percent target.
zh: 随着投资者为下周密集的央行会议布局，美元跌势在周四暂歇。日本、美国和欧洲的货币政策制定者预计都将维持利率不变，但会释放偏鹰派信号。市场预计美联储本月将联邦基金利率维持在3.75%至4%区间，12月加息概率较高；欧洲央行预计将基准利率维持在2.5%；日本央行则要等到明年初才会把利率上调至1.5%。日本政策制定者表示，基础通胀已相当接近2%的目标。
vocab: adj. 鹰派的、倾向收紧货币的
phr. 计入、反映在价格中

title: Gold Slides as Oil Revives Inflation Fears
en: Gold fell more than 1 percent on Thursday to its lowest since October 14, as surging crude prices revived inflation fears and strengthened the case for interest rates staying higher for longer. Spot bullion slipped to about 4,094 dollars an ounce and silver dropped 2.6 percent to 56.44 dollars. Traders now see only a 16 percent chance of a US rate rise at the Federal Reserve meeting next week, but roughly 90 percent odds of a move in December. Oil climbed after repeated attacks in Saudi Arabia prompted Washington to order some diplomats and their families to leave the country.
zh: 受原油价格飙升重新点燃通胀担忧影响，黄金周四下跌逾1%，创10月14日以来最低，市场对利率更长时间维持高位的预期进一步增强。现货金跌至约每盎司4094美元，白银下跌2.6%至56.44美元。交易员认为美联储下周会议加息概率仅16%，但12月加息概率约90%。沙特接连遭袭后，美国下令部分外交人员及家属撤离，推动油价上行。

title: Ukraine Peace Talks Back on the Table
en: The Kremlin said President Putin is ready to resume trilateral talks with Washington and Kyiv in mid-November, the first such format in months. President Zelensky said Ukraine could accept a peace deal based on retaining control of at least 75 percent of its territory, and signalled willingness to freeze the current line to open negotiations. He also backed a full ceasefire, a halt to strikes on energy infrastructure and prisoner exchanges, while cautioning about the outcome. Diplomats say any deal still depends on security guarantees. Separately, Kyiv said ballistic missile attacks on the capital injured five people.
zh: 克里姆林宫表示，普京总统准备在11月中旬重启与华盛顿和基辅的三方会谈，这是数月来首次恢复该对话机制。泽连斯基总统表示，乌克兰可以接受在保留至少75%领土控制权基础上的和平协议，并表示愿意“冻结现状”以开启谈判。他还支持全面停火、停止袭击能源基础设施以及战俘交换，同时对谈判结果持谨慎态度。外交人士表示，任何协议仍取决于安全保障。此外，基辅称首都遭弹道导弹袭击，造成5人受伤。

title: Middle East on the Brink Again
en: The United States ordered non-emergency government employees and their families to leave Saudi Arabia, citing the risk of renewed hostilities, particularly with Yemen's Houthi movement. A drone attack on a Saudi Aramco oil field killed two people and injured two others, while Washington imposed a fresh round of sanctions on Iran. Reports said Israel had prepared a large-scale strike on Iran last month but called it off after President Trump objected before the midterm elections. The United States is also sending a third aircraft carrier and about 10,000 extra troops to the region.
zh: 美国以敌对行动可能重启（尤其是与也门胡塞武装的冲突）为由，下令驻沙特的非紧急政府雇员及家属撤离。沙特阿美一处油田遭无人机袭击，造成2人死亡、2人受伤，美国同时宣布对伊朗实施新一轮制裁。有报道称以色列上月曾准备对伊朗发动大规模打击，但因特朗普总统反对在中期选举前开战而叫停。美国还向该地区增派第三艘航母和约1万名士兵。

title: France Becomes the Euro Area Weak Link
en: France's 10-year government bond yield climbed above 5 percent for the first time since 2002, pushing the spread over German bunds to its widest since 2011. Weekend unrest, fuelled in part by cuts to public services, has shown how politically difficult it will be to bring the budget deficit under control, and analysts warn that Paris could become the source of a fresh debt crisis in the euro area. Police imposed a third night-time curfew in central Paris this week, and President Macron, visiting Doha, vowed zero tolerance for rioters.
zh: 法国10年期国债收益率升破5%，为2002年以来首次，与德国国债的利差扩大至2011年以来最宽。上周末的骚乱部分由公共服务削减引发，显示出压缩财政赤字在政治上多么艰难；分析人士警告，法国可能成为欧元区新一轮债务危机的源头。巴黎警方本周第三次在市中心实施夜间宵禁，正在多哈访问的马克龙总统承诺对骚乱者零容忍。

title: AI Factories, on Earth and on the Moon
en: Nvidia used its GTC conference in Berlin to unveil DSX POD, a modular AI factory that it says can cut deployment time from roughly six months to as little as 14 days, with global deliveries due in early 2027. Chief executive Jensen Huang also announced supply agreements with six partners to lift substrate capacity 2.5-fold, advanced packaging by more than 300 percent and optical engines fifteenfold within three years. Meanwhile, HPE said its fourth-generation Spaceborne Computer, a fanless module the size of a graphics card, will run high-performance computing benchmarks on the lunar south pole.
zh: 英伟达在柏林GTC大会上发布模块化AI工厂DSX POD，称可把部署时间从约6个月压缩到最短14天，并计划2027年初开始全球交付。首席执行官黄仁勋还宣布与六家伙伴签署供货协议，三年内将基板产能提升2.5倍、先进封装提升逾300%、光学引擎扩产15倍。与此同时，惠普企业表示，其第四代星载计算机——一块只有显卡大小的无风扇模块——将在月球南极运行高性能计算基准测试。
